articles.title: Letter: The Pocket Park on Wren Street Needs Attention
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the February meeting. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Please keep the pocket park in the budget. Many of us on Wren Street use it every week.
Wanda Lombardi, Foundry Row
